description: Source file implementing response handlers for FAPI protocol messages related to 3GPP specifications, including handling parameter responses, configuration responses, stop indications, slot indications, and error indications within the 'p5' context.

classes.name: p5_responses_handler
classes.description: Class handling various response and indication messages in the P5 protocol context, managing transaction outcomes and logging.

methods.name: on_param_response
methods.description: Handles parameter response messages, setting transaction outcome based on message error code.

methods.name: on_config_response
methods.description: Handles configuration response messages, resetting slot indication flag and setting transaction outcome.

methods.name: on_stop_indication
methods.description: Handles stop indication messages, marking stop response as successful.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication
methods.description: Processes slot indication, sets start outcome once, and marks slot indication as processed.

methods.name: on_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indications, setting outcomes based on message type and logging warnings.
